scope: Read-only all-page source-to-published text/link/anchor/image/table/diagram checks plus current review-register reconciliation.

residualEnglishReview.currentSemanticScope: The existing AI sentence-level review and independent residual-English review remain applicable to unchanged units. All review inputs match their recorded hashes except exactly four explicitly reviewed Journaling tag corrections, recorded separately. This run revalidates structure, state, placeholders and contextual output; it does not claim to re-read 58463 translations semantically.

knownPresentationIssue: Empty inline SVG placeholders are counted separately from image references. The frontend agent is restoring their original geometry; the all-page text/asset checks do not by themselves establish the final visual icon result.
limitations: Source-to-published comparisons use the captured structured source; raw-HTML extraction coverage is being independently audited by another agent.
External hyperlinks are checked for faithful target preservation, not remote HTTP availability.
All table cells are structurally checked and reviewed-unit states reconciled; this run is not a new sentence-by-sentence semantic reread of every cell.
SVG/image assets retain original bytes; no new OCR or embedded-image text translation review is claimed.
